co60-right.display_channel_rule: All 34 hash-verified channels are selectable; the walkthrough starts on the largest absolute terminal induced response. The static overview shows two contacts per face with largest absolute terminal induced charge.
co60-right.display_trace_policy: Exact retained display samples, without new rounding, resampling or peak fitting. Full native inputs and complete replay stay local.

replay.trace_and_scalar_policy: Exact canonical trace SHA256 and scalar JSON equality

co60-right.selection_rule: first accepted unambiguous pulse group in original ID order; otherwise first accepted

trace_conventions.charge_fC: Raw signed SSD induced charge before fixed family wiring
trace_conventions.current_nA: Current after fixed family wiring; original integration bin, not display-point interval
trace_conventions.preamp_V: Signed preamplifier output driven by fixed-wiring current
trace_conventions.shaped_V: Signed shaper voltage with configured electronics inversion
